workHistory.summary: GenAI roadmap for 20+ enterprise applications, targeting materially shorter R&D and clinical operations timelines. Built a 35+ person engineering organization delivering production LLM workflows on AWS for global manufacturing. Translated AI capabilities for the C-suite; secured multi-million-dollar investments and partnerships with OpenAI and AWS.

Senior engineering leader for large-scale conversational AI and multi-agent orchestration across Alexa, managing 35+ direct reports and 110+ partner-team reports across 8+ countries. Architected and launched Alexa's first multi-agent conversational switching framework (celebrity and Disney partner agents), underpinning a business generating $50M+ in annual recurring revenue. Built and scaled multi-disciplinary teams of 35+ engineers across regions, driving cross-org alignment across Alexa AI, retail, device, and international engineering.

Led the multi-agent conversational AI framework's rollout for monetization and engagement measurement across celebrity personalities. Launched Alexa Voice Shopping across ten countries: US, India, Japan, Canada, France, Italy, Spain, Mexico, Ireland, and Australia. Led integration of speech recognition, NLP, contextual understanding, and response orchestration; defined APIs for ML-powered interactions in the Amazon India retail app at millions of daily active users.

Founding technical member of the Alexa India Retail team, building the organization from scratch to 16+ engineers and analysts. Architected the APIs and ML endpoints that integrated Alexa voice shopping into the Amazon India retail app, enabling millions of users to shop by voice.

Reduced a three-year country launch timeline to nine months for Amazon’s first retail entry in Southeast Asia by decoupling legacy US-centric systems; sole technical owner aligning 26 teams and seven global organizations. Designed the region’s first end-to-end digital marketing and last-mile logistics stack, including two-hour delivery in Singapore and automated customer lifecycle marketing.

Distributed services and fraud detection for Amazon Register; global merchant onboarding and financial portal integrations. Fault-tolerant payment infrastructure in Java and C++. Tech lead across Seattle and Bangalore for cross-site delivery and merchant-facing integrations.
